changes: Fully rebranded CHANGELOG.md from Koala to Lattice via case-preserving substitution (49 -> 0 koala), including version titles (Koala 0.3.x -> Lattice 0.3.x), product-name prose, koala-lab, and all historical technical tokens (@koala-agent, koala commands, .koala paths, bin/koala.js, koala.config).
usage: CHANGELOG.md now reads as a fully Lattice-branded changelog for OSS. Run `git grep -i koala CHANGELOG.md` to confirm 0 hits.
expectedOutcome: git grep -i koala CHANGELOG.md returns nothing; build + validate green; markdown intact.
actualTranscript: git grep -i koala CHANGELOG.md -> 0 (exit 1); npm run build -> exit 0; lattice validate -> ALL PASS; 5 version headings preserved as Lattice 0.x.x.
limitations: The CHANGELOG history is now intentionally non-literal (it describes past changes using current lattice names, e.g. .lattice/ where the past was actually .koala/) - a deliberate user choice for a clean OSS changelog over truthful history. One entry (B-3d39) became tautological after the rebrand.
pitfalls: CHANGELOG.md is excluded from the koala-residue gate, so a future koala re-introduction there is NOT caught by the gate - rely on review/grep for CHANGELOG specifically.
